title: The Secret Adversary — Chapter 1 Beat Inventory (Reunion and the Joint Venture)
adaptation_scope: Excerpt covering Tommy and Tuppence's chance meeting at Dover Street Tube, their conversation at Lyons' tea shop, the formation of the Young Adventurers, Ltd., their parting, and the stranger's approach in St. James's Park.

source_unit_treatments.reason: Greeting line; part of reunion beat.
Greeting reply; part of reunion beat.
Tommy's invitation triggers the move to tea.
Walk to Lyons'; introduces Tuppence's name and her noticing his anxiety.
Tommy admits demobilization and lack of money.
Tuppence insists they pay separately; arrive at Lyons'.
Tommy mentions the overheard name 'Jane Finn' — setup for later.
Physical description; informs character design but not a story operation.
Tuppence's wartime history and current jobless status.
Tommy's parallel war history and ten months of fruitless job-hunting.
Tommy explains refusing his uncle's adoption.
Tuppence's parallel desperation and home life.
Tuppence's monologue on money and intent to marry it.
Tuppence admits she meets no rich men.
Idea of being hired to commit crimes.
Tuppence calls for paper to draft advertisement.
Tuppence defends ad and hands it to him for the Times.
Tommy decides to commit to the plan.
Tuppence rises to leave for hostel.
They part; Tuppence walks home through park for economy.
A stranger asks to speak to her — chapter hook.
